words.enExample: Keep the receipt in case you want to return the shoes later.
words.zhExample: 把收据留好，以防你之后想退这双鞋。
words.note: 拼写陷阱：p 不发音，读作 /rɪˈsiːt/；与 receive 同族（cei- 中 i 在 e 前）。高频搭配：keep the receipt（留好收据）、a receipt for...（...的收据）。网购退货时客服第一句常问：Do you have the receipt?

words.meaning: 家务杂事；琐碎的活儿；苦差事
words.enExample: Doing the dishes is the chore I hate the most, but someone has to do it.
words.zhExample: 洗碗是我最讨厌的家务，但总得有人做。
words.note: 常用复数 chores，指"家里那一堆杂活"。高频搭配：do the chores（做家务）、household chores（家务活）。口语里 a chore 还可比喻"乏味的苦差事"：Filling out forms is such a chore.

words.enExample: My colleague shared her notes with me so I could catch up quickly.
words.zhExample: 同事把她的笔记分享给我，好让我尽快跟上进度。
words.note: col-（共同）+ league（联盟）→ "同一团队的人"。重音在第一音节，结尾读 /ɡ/ 不是 /dʒ/。近义：coworker（更口语）、workmate。注意拼写双 l：colleague，别写成 coleague。

words.enExample: We'd better tackle this problem now instead of putting it off until Friday.
words.zhExample: 我们最好现在就着手解决这个问题，别拖到周五。
words.note: 原义是橄榄球里的"擒抱摔倒"→ 引申为"迎面解决难题"。高频搭配：tackle a problem / issue / challenge。近义辨析：solve 强调"解开、解决掉"，tackle 强调"着手应对"的过程。

words.enExample: Please let me know which time is convenient for a quick meeting.
words.zhExample: 请告诉我哪个时间方便开个短会。
words.note: con-（共同）+ ven-（来）→ "都凑到一起"就是方便。高频搭配：convenient for sb（对某人方便）、at your convenience（在你方便时）。注意：主语通常是时间或地点，说 "I'm convenient" 是中式英语错误。

essay.title: Lessons from a Broken Umbrella
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: My umbrella broke on a Tuesday, in the middle of a rain I had not planned for. One rib folded the wrong way, and suddenly the whole thing became a wet question mark over my head. I stood under a shop awning and laughed despite myself.

For years I had treated umbrellas as disposable. Buy cheap, lose often, buy again. But this one had been a gift, brown-handled and stubborn, and it had stayed with me through three cities. Repairing it felt less like thrift than like keeping a promise.

The repairman at the market barely looked up. He pressed the rib back, tied it with wire, and charged me nothing, saying only that good things deserve a second chance. On the way home the rain got heavier, and the umbrella held.

I have thought about that sentence all week. We replace what we could mend, and mend only what we still love. Perhaps the difference between an object and a companion is simply the number of chances we are willing to give it.

The wire has rusted a little now, and I have decided to leave it that way. A repaired thing should be allowed to show where it was broken. Mine did, and it kept the rain off my shoulders for one more autumn.
translations: 我的伞在一个周二坏了，坏在一场我没料到的雨里。一根伞骨朝反方向折过去，整把伞瞬间成了头顶一个湿漉漉的问号。我站在店铺的雨棚下，忍不住笑出声来。
多年来我一直把伞当成一次性的东西。买便宜的，常弄丢，再买一把。可这一把是别人送的，棕色手柄，倔强得很，跟着我走过了三座城市。修好它与其说是节俭，不如说是守一个约定。
市场里的修伞师傅几乎没抬头。他把伞骨压回去，用铁丝缠紧，分文未收，只说好东西值得第二次机会。回家路上雨更大了，伞却撑住了。
那一整周我都在想这句话。我们总是换掉本可以修补的东西，却只修补仍然心爱的东西。也许一件物品与一个伙伴之间的差别，不过就是我们愿意给它的机会的次数。
那截铁丝如今锈了一点，我决定就让它锈着。修补过的东西，应该被允许露出它曾经断过的地方。我的伞露了，而它又替我挡了一个秋天的雨。

grammar.point: less like...than like... 比较结构
grammar.example: "Repairing it felt less like thrift than like keeping a promise."
grammar.note: less like A than like B 表示「与其说像 A，不如说像 B」，用否定式的比较把重心推到后者。句中强调修伞的动机不是省钱，而是守约。 举一反三：举一反三：同类结构还有 more like...than...，如 it felt more like a gift than a purchase。

grammar.example: "He pressed the rib back, tied it with wire, and charged me nothing, saying only that good things deserve a second chance."
grammar.note: saying 是现在分词短语，放在并列谓语之后作伴随状语，补充说明前面动作同时发生的话语，让句子读起来更有画面感。 举一反三：举一反三：可换成其他感官动词，如 he left, smiling to himself。

grammar.point: 定语从句省略关系代词
grammar.example: "Perhaps the difference between an object and a companion is simply the number of chances we are willing to give it."
grammar.note: chances 后省略了关系代词 that/which，因为它作 give 的宾语，口语与书面语中都常见。be willing to do 表示「愿意做某事」。 举一反三：举一反三：关系代词作宾语皆可省略，如 the book I bought yesterday。

vocab.enExample: One rib of the umbrella bent in the wind.
vocab.zhExample: 伞的一根伞骨被风吹弯了。
vocab.note: 用法：伞面下的支撑骨架，也可指人体肋骨

vocab.enExample: We waited under the awning until the rain eased.
vocab.zhExample: 我们在雨棚下等到雨小些。
vocab.note: 用法：店铺门外遮雨遮阳的布篷

vocab.enExample: He refused to treat friendship as disposable.
vocab.zhExample: 他不肯把友情当成一次性的东西。
vocab.note: 用法：形容不打算长期使用、坏了就换的物品

vocab.enExample: The old lock was stubborn but still worked.
vocab.zhExample: 那把旧锁很倔，却还能用。
vocab.note: 用法：可形容人坚持己见，也可形容物件结实难对付

vocab.enExample: Thrift is not the same as being mean.
vocab.note: 用法：指谨慎使用资源、不浪费的习惯

vocab.enExample: She mended the tear in her coat by hand.
vocab.zhExample: 她手工把外套上的破口补好了。
vocab.note: 用法：多用于衣物、器物等小修小补

vocab.zhExample: 好工具值得被好好保养。
vocab.note: 用法：指因品质或行为而应当得到某种对待

vocab.enExample: The gate has rusted after years of rain.
vocab.zhExample: 那扇门经年累月的雨已经生了锈。
vocab.note: 用法：金属氧化，也可指技能久不练习而退化
